messages:
jordan: Heads-up — I'm sketching a migration from org/project-scoped API keys to per-route capability tokens for a subset of sensitive endpoints (model-management, billing-webhooks, admin routes). Want to capture tradeoffs and an ops-safe rollout plan.
nikki: +1 to capturing tradeoffs. Why per-route instead of scoped roles + RBAC?
jordan: Main reasons: 1) least-privilege for long-lived machine clients (reduces blast radius), 2) easier to issue ephemeral tokens with narrow surface (short TTL + no long-lived secrets), 3) simpler runtime enforcement (gateway checks token capabilities vs evaluating role graph).
sam: Concern: proliferation of token types and secret management for customers. We'll need clear SDK helpers and a migration story for current project keys.
priya: Also consider background workers and cron jobs that need broad access. They often can't handle frequent rotations. How do we support them?
jordan: Two patterns: a) Reserve a long-lived "worker-role" token with explicit, audited capabilities and rate limits, b) prefer short-lived role-assertions minted by an operator service (on-prem: via KMS/HSM + mTLS). Document will include both.
nikki: Enforcement detail: who validates the token capability? Edge/Gateway or upstream service? If edge only, we avoid auth logic duplications. If upstream, we can do richer claims checks.
priya: I'd push for Gateway-first enforcement with signed introspection for a11y of complex checks. Gateway validates capability scope and TTL; services only trust gateway or do local introspect via signed token (JWS) — eliminates a network roundtrip for every request.
sam: What about RBAC mapping for org admins? We still need human-facing roles (org-admin, billing-admin). Those map to capability sets, right?
jordan: Exactly — map RBAC roles to capability bundles during minting. Admin UI issues a capability token representing that bundle. We don't change RBAC model, just how we expose and enforce machine creds.
nikki: Migration plan thoughts: Phase 1: opt-in capability tokens for new endpoints + SDK helpers. Phase 2: telemetry + detect callers using broad keys. Phase 3: recommend/issue tokens to callers and gradually deprecate old key use.
priya: Telemetry: add a metric for "requests using broad project-key" per endpoint, and an alert when >5% of traffic to sensitive endpoints uses broad keys after adoption window.
sam: Rotation story: require rotation by default for long-lived worker-role tokens every 90 days. Provide a token-rewriter CLI and API so operators can swap tokens without downtime.
jordan: Edge cases: 1) third-party webhooks (can't rotate easily) -> support static signed webhook secrets with scoped verification; 2) cross-project service calls -> support delegated tokens with limited TTL; 3) rate-limit impact when splitting tokens per-route.
nikki: Security review: need proof-of-concept for gateway validation using JWS with key rotation. Also threat model on token theft and replay during TTL window. Consider nonce or one-time-use for very sensitive ops.
priya: On-prem considerations: minting flow should be possible offline — allow customer-managed signing keys (HSM) and an operator-run mint service. Document key rollout + emergency revocation.
sam: SDK changes: expose a capability builder, `client.issueCapability({resources, actions, ttl})`, and transparent caching/rotation. Also update templates in our quickstarts.
jordan: I'll draft a short RFC with the above + diagrams: minting paths, gateway validation, delegation patterns, migration phases, and sample CLI commands.
nikki: Can you include a small code sample for token validation at the gateway? e.g.:
```
// pseudo
const claims = verifyJWS(token, gatewayPublicKey)
if (!claims.capabilities.includes('model:write')) return 403
```
priya: Love that. Also include failure modes and fallback: when gateway can't verify (key rotation), fall back to introspection endpoint with HMAC one-time cookie.
deploy-bot: Deployed infra-test: auth-gateway/jwt-verify v0.1 -> staging at 2024-06-12T14:02:10Z :rocket:
nikki: OK — next steps: Jordan files RFC by EOD Friday, include migration checklist + metrics. I'll set up a short sync w/solutions and platform.
jordan: Thanks — I'll drop a draft link here when ready. :thumbsup:
